title: City Hall: Licenses, Sewer Payments & Refunds
summary:
*   **Early "Service" Car Drivers Licensed:** The city approved applications for individuals to operate "service" cars, likely for hire.
*   **Sewer Bill Remission Approved:** A resident received an $8 credit on their sewer bill due to their property being vacant for extended periods across several years.
*   **Compensation for Sewage Damage:** The city paid $21 to a homeowner whose property was damaged by a sewage backup earlier in the year.

"Regular meeting of the City Council : Austin, Texas, October 07, 1915: The Council was
called to order by the Mayor: Roll called: Present Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen Anthony,
Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Absent none: The minutes of the last regular and subsequent
recessed meetings were read and adopted:
Reports of City Officers:
The Mayor laid before the Council the reports of the Assessor & Collector of taxes, the
Asst City Clerk, the Fire Marshal ,the City Marshal & the City Health Officer, which were
read and ordered filed: The following applications for license as Drivers of 'Service'
cars, were presented Driver licenses
read and taken under advisement.
R F Trousdale, & Chas E Crawford:
October 11th 1915:
Councilman Powell offered the following resolution : Resolved by the City Council of the
City of Austin H B Armstrong That $ 8.00 .of the charge for $ 27.00, for sanitary sewer
service ,made against the premis Sewer Charge -is at 2628 Wichita street in this City and
owned by H B Armstrong, but occupied by J T remitted Patterson, lessee, be remitted by
reason of the vacancy of said premises for 3 months in the summer of 1913, 4 months of the
summer of 1914, and 4 months of the summer of 1915, and
Be it further resolved :
That the Cashier of the Sanitary Sewer Dept, of the City of Austin, Texas, be entitled and
instructed to take credit upon his accounts in accordance with the terms of this
resolution.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none.
Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor.
The Mayor laid before the Council applications for Drivers 1 license from the following
named persons, viz: Driver licenses Giles Harris, 202 East 23rd street & L J Johnson, 1310
West 5th street: The applications were granted by the following vote: Yeas Mayor
Wooldridge, Councilmen Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none: Councilman
Powell offered the following resolution : Resolved by the City Council of the City of
Austin : That the sum of $ 21.00, be and the same is hereby appropriated out of the
Sanitary W D Hart Sewer Earnings Fund for the year 1915, in payment in full for
damagessustained by W D Hart, Damages at his premises at 1205 San Antonio street in this
City, caused by the backing up of sewage into said premises on the night of April 22nd,
1915.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony, HXK Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none.
Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor.
Jno. Johnson
The Council then adjourned. City Clerk
